current_date: 1 November 2022 (date the joint North Devon/Torridge Local List came into effect, per Torridge DC news release 'Local List brings clarity to northern Devon planning submissions', Nov 2022); companion Local List Matrix dated September 2023
current_evidence: The council's 'The Local List' page still offers only the North Devon Local List PDF (741 KB) plus a 'Local List Matrix - September 2023', and planning.data.gov.uk (entry 2026-10-16) records this same November 2022 PDF as North Devon's validation checklist, so no newer list was found.

issues.detail: Coal Mining Risk Assessment is placed under Householder, Listed building consent, Lawful development cert, Change of use - prior approval, Demolition in cons area, Works to trees and Hazardous substances. These are exactly the application types the source EXCLUDES from this requirement. Grokbot read the 'other than' exclusion list as an inclusion list.
issues.evidence: Item 6 Coal Mining Risk Assessment: 'development proposals located in an area defined as "high risk area" by the Coal Authority, other than: householder development, heritage consents (listed building and conservation area consent, lawful development certificates, prior notification (any type) hazardous substances consents and tree or hedgerow works'

issues.detail: Around 25 requirements are marked 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning', so they appear only under Full planning. Several apply to all planning applications, so they should also appear under Householder and Outline. Examples: the Wildlife Trigger List is mandatory for ALL planning applications. The Flood Risk Assessment applies to all applications in flood zone 2/3 or critical drainage areas. The AIA applies wherever trees could be affected, and the Heritage Statement to planning applications in conservation areas. Outline gets only the Design and Access Statement, and Householder gets only the (wrongly placed) coal mining item.
issues.evidence: Biodiversity: 'A Wildlife Trigger List (WTL) must be completed and submitted with all planning applications'; Item 12 FRA: 'All planning applications for: development within ... flood zone 2 and/or flood zone 3 ...'

issues.detail: The Heritage Statement (item 17) is listed only under Listed building consent. The source also requires it for major applications affecting conservation areas, for planning applications within conservation areas (including demolition), and for applications affecting heritage assets. It is missing from Full planning, Householder and Demolition in cons area.
issues.evidence: Item 17: 'listed building consent applications; major planning applications within or otherwise affecting conservation areas; planning applications for developments within conservation areas, including demolition ...'

issues.detail: The Health Impact Assessment is placed under 'Hazardous substances' (hazardous substances consent). The source triggers it for any development that raises public-health risks, one of which is the storage or use of hazardous substances. It is not specific to hazardous substances consent applications, and it is missing from Full/Outline.
issues.evidence: Item 16: 'any development that may give rise to a risk to public health and safety concerns due to: coastal erosion and land instability; ... contamination ...; or the storage or use of hazardous substances.'

issues.detail: Several requirement labels carry trigger text copied from a DIFFERENT local-list item. 'Advertisement drawings / illumination details' and 'Character / Conservation area appraisal reference' both carry the Lighting Impact Assessment (item 21) text. 'Ecological Survey / Assessment' carries the Archaeological Assessment (item 4) text. 'Pre-application advice / engagement details' carries the Air Quality (item 2) text. 'Waste / Refuse and recycling storage' carries the Ventilation/Extraction (item 37) text. 'Minerals / Waste specific statements (county matters)' is really the Waste Audit Statement (item 36, major development). 'Drainage Strategy / SuDS' carries the Foul Drainage Assessment (item 13) text, so no surface-water/SuDS trigger is captured.
issues.evidence: Ecological Survey row: '...Standing Advice for Protected Species 15 Joint NDC/TDC validation checklist 4) Archaeological Assessment When is this required? where development is proposed on a site which includes ... archaeological interest.'

issues.detail: Some trigger excerpts are fragments that do not say when the requirement applies. Schedule of works (listed building): 'associated arboricultural method statement.' Retail/Town Centre: 'other main town centre uses.' Photographs: 'All photographs must be fully annotated...'. Site levels: 'plan showing finished floor levels and estimated flood levels, will be required.' Marketing: 'an appropriate marketing exercise ... 12-month period'. Highways/access: the trigger is location/block-plan boilerplate ('...A north point The scale used, a scale bar...'). Viability and Open Space are cut off mid-sentence.
issues.evidence: Schedule of works row trigger_excerpt: 'associated arboricultural method statement.'

issues.detail: 'Statement of Community Involvement' is really the Pre-application Consultation Statement (item 28). It applies only to wind farm proposals for two or more turbines, or where hub height is over 15 m. The generic SCI label overstates its scope.
issues.evidence: '28) Pre-application Consultation Statement When is this required? wind farm development proposals for two or more turbines, or where the turbine hub height is greater than 15 metres.'

issues.detail: The Crime and Disorder Statement is not captured. It is required for major development proposals, for the provision or alteration of a take-away, for the provision or alteration of a public house or licensed premises, and for public toilets. The source's numbered items run to at least 37. Grokbot's rows cite items 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 11, 12, 13, 16, 17, 20, 21, 24, 25, 27, 28, 31, 33, 34, 36 and 37. Several numbered items (e.g. 1, 5, 8, 10, 15, 18, 22, 23, 26, 29, 30, 32, 35) have no identifiable row, so further requirements are probably missing. They could not be named because the PDF is robots-blocked.
issues.evidence: Torridge web version of joint list, Crime and Disorder Statement: 'major development proposals; the provision or alteration of a take-away; the provision or alteration of a public house or licensed premises; and public toilets'

issues.detail: 'Drainage Strategy / SuDS' and 'Foul Sewage / Utilities Statement' carry the identical item 13 Foul Drainage Assessment trigger. The item 21 lighting text also appears under three different requirement names (Advertisement drawings, Character/CA appraisal, Lighting Assessment).
issues.evidence: Both rows: '13) Foul Drainage Assessment When is this required? development proposals that would result in the disposal of foul sewage ... not through a mains connection to a public sewer.'

issues.detail: The 'Drawing / document standards' tab_items are PDF fragments with page headers and running text, not local requirements. Examples: 'It would be appreciated if the scale of the plans and paper size is no larger than is required ... 3 Joint NDC/TDC validation checklist Part One National Requirements The relevant application form...', 'A north point; and The scale used...', and a block mixing site-plan content with the 'Reports and Supporting Documentation' introduction. Fire Statement and Design and Access Statement are national, not local, requirements.
issues.evidence: tab_items[0]: '...3 Joint NDC/TDC validation checklist Part One National Requirements The relevant application form There are a range of application forms...'

issues.detail: The reference row says 'Joint / shared list: null', 'Shared service / partnership: none identified' and 'council-specific (no shared list identified)'. The document is in fact the joint North Devon Council / Torridge District Council validation checklist, a single Local List produced by both councils and in effect from 1 November 2022.
issues.evidence: Page headers in extracted text: 'Joint NDC/TDC validation checklist'; Torridge news: joint Local List 'came into effect on 1 November 2022'

issues.detail: The council page says the Local List Matrix (September 2023) 'is routinely reviewed, so please ensure you have the latest version'. Grokbot read the matrix but did not use it to assign requirements to application types; instead it fell back on INFERRED placements.
issues.evidence: The Local List page: 'Download the Local List Matrix - September 2023'

summary: Grokbot's November 2022 joint NDC/TDC list appears still current: no newer list was found, and the PDF and Matrix are robots-blocked, so the contents were only partly verified. The extraction has serious placement errors: Coal Mining is assigned to exactly the application types the source excludes, and universal requirements are confined to Full planning. Many triggers are mislabelled or fragmentary, and the Crime and Disorder Statement and likely other numbered items are missing.
